_readme: The Castilian, 2323 San Antonio St, as js/slopes-apartments.js draws it. One 1969 slab: a full-site podium (retail ground floor, the parking garage behind a vertical metal fin screen, the level-11 amenity floor glazed dark) with the residential tower standing on its roof deck. Metres in the footprint's oriented bounding box (js/westcampus.js obbOf): L=77.0, W=36.9 as obbOf computes it (the ring itself is 77.45 x 36.86). u=0 is the NORTH end and +u runs SOUTH; v=0 is the WEST (San Antonio St) edge and +v runs EAST - confirmed against the console's frame line, see _frame_src. Every number carries a _src naming a key in `sources`, or says derived or unknown. Read docs/apartments.md for the schema.
name: The Castilian

sources.S1: data/snapshots/2026-08-27/buildings.detailed.geojson feature 307878e3-63d2-471c-83d1-6b405de9e7b7: name 'The Castilian', num_floors 22, final_height 60.0, source_height 'hero_override'; the footprint is a clean 4-vertex rectangle, 77.45 x 36.86 m (2,855 m2), long axis at bearing 184.9 deg.
sources.S2: sixthriver.com/castilian-1 (Sixthriver Architects, who did the 2015 $20M renovation for American Campus Communities): '22-Story High Rise', 344 units, originally constructed 1969, 11th floor is the amenity level - full-service kitchen and dining hall, study lounges, computer lab, laundry, gym.
sources.S3: educationsnapshots.com/projects/6742 (the same project, photographs by Casey Dunn): 22 floors; level 1 leasing office + retail; LEVELS 2-10 ARE THE PARKING GARAGE; level 11 amenities; levels 12-22 private rooms and shared suites.
sources.S4: educationsnapshots photograph 'american-campus-communities-the-castilian-1200x897' (ref/edusnap_00.jpg in the session scratchpad): the south-west corner in sun - the vertical metal fin screen over the garage, the dark navy glazed band at the top of the podium, the white spandrel band above the fins, the recessed dark ground floor under the podium overhang.
sources.S5: educationsnapshots photograph 'the-castilian-700x895' (ref/edusnap_02.jpg): the head-on San Antonio St elevation at the AMERICAN CAMPUS LEASING CENTER entrance, address plate 2323 - the fin screen at full resolution, the entrance canopy, the ground-floor storefront. Scale from a standing person, 1.7 m = 58 px -> 0.0293 m/px.
sources.S6: American Campus Communities gallery photograph 674-01-exterior-gallery (crop_tower.png in the session scratchpad; that copy is mirrored left-right, which does not move any measurement used here): the tower in sun, near head-on - the pale piers, the mid-grey spandrels, the dark glass, the charcoal core strip with the vertical CASTILIAN sign, the blank pale end wall with the ACC logo, the dark crown band under the parapet.
sources.S7: thedailytexan.com 2023 photograph 2-2-23_CastillianConditions_PeytonSims (ref/dailytexan_00.jpg): the east elevation from W 24th and Guadalupe under overcast - 11 window rows counted on the tower by a blueness profile at three columns, the amenity floor's dark glass band, the core strip and its sign on this face too.
sources.S8: Google Earth 3D, imagery 12/3/2023, captured 2026-09-05 with scripts/verify/chrome.mjs on hardware GL and page.screenshot(): nadir (camera 510 m, 30d17'14.31"N 97d44'32.67"W, scale bar 165 px = 30 m), obliques from the NW and the SW (328 m). The nadir was fitted in the building's own frame - a 10 m grid on the podium roof outline at 0.065 m per crop pixel - and every plan number below was read off that gridded plan with the roof-height parallax taken out (the tower roof stands 30 m above the podium roof and displaces radially outward by a factor 1.083).
sources.S9: scripts/bake_westcampus.py BUILDINGS['The Castilian'] and docs/PASS_WESTCAMPUS.md: 60.0 m, 22 storeys, 1967 (S2 says 1969), painted concrete with punched windows, base band 4.6 m, a garage podium, the amenity floor at 11 - the same programme S3 states, sourced independently.
sources.S10: docs/entrances/westcampus.md row 3: address 2323 San Antonio St, front elevation WEST on San Antonio (two OSM footway ends at 30.28769/30.28770), base band 4.60 m, retail suite + Castilian Cafe in the podium, the garage entry a ramp mouth on the west elevation.
sources.S11: js/westcampus.js SOLID trios, as The Standard's file uses them: the day/golden/night relationship for a deck and for a mechanical unit.
sources.derived: a number computed from the above and marked so; 'unknown' stays unknown.
sources.S12: Casey Dunn / Sixthriver photographs in austin-reference-images/the-castilian (01 SW aerial, 03 SW street corner, 08 S aerial), camera solved by least squares on the podium corners (scratchpad cam.py): 01 eye 21 m up, 72 m south of the south face; the tower end wall spans v 11.6-26.6 on the south face, the pier under it v 15.9-22.3, the fin-screened west return v 0-15.2.
sources.S13: Owner night photo IMG_9970 (2026-09-18 20:55, iPhone 16 Pro 24 mm eq.), camera solved on the podium's two west corners: the tower's west face runs u -0.7 to 76.9 (the full podium), end pier 3.7 m, eight 3.9 m bays, the core strip u 35.4-43.4 carrying THE CASTILIAN, eight bays, end pier. Tower roof about 62 m.

footprint._src: S1 verbatim. In (u,v) the four corners are (0,0) (0,36.86) (77.45,36.86) (77.45,0) - the polygon IS its own oriented bounding box, so every edge is axis-parallel in the frame.

_frame_src: obbOf(ring) as the generator computes it, read off the boot console line: `[slopes-apartments] The Castilian: obb L=77.0 W=36.9, +u at bearing 184.9 deg`. +u runs SOUTH, so u=0 is the north end; +v is 90 deg counter-clockwise from +u in (east, north), i.e. EAST, so v=0 is the west (San Antonio St) edge. The ring measures 77.45 x 36.86 m corner to corner; the obb is 0.45 m shorter because it is fitted to the rotated hull.

levels._src: Podium: ground 0-4.4 recessed, white fascia 4.4-6.4, fin screen 6.4-20.2 (three tiers), white fascia 20.2-21.8, amenity glass 21.8-25.0, white band and deck 25.6, parapet to 26.8 - the fascia/glass/fascia ratio 0.56:1:0.5 read off S13 and S12/03. Tower: eleven 3.0 m floors 25.6-58.6, white crown to 60.3, parapet to 61.5 (S12 01 solve puts the end-wall top at 59.3 and the attic rail at 61-63; S13 at 62).
levels._heights_src: deck 25.6 + podium parapet 0.9 = 26.5; tower roof 58.6 + parapet 1.4 = 60.0 = S1's final_height. That 60.0 is a hero/LiDAR high point, and the mechanical penthouse stands above it (roofItems).

colours._src: day hex; golden and night follow js/westcampus.js's ramp() unless a full trio is given. Every hex is the median of a named crop of a named photograph.

glass._src: S12/03 tower glass #353b66 (shade) and #4b6b8f (sky reflection); entered between, blue - the old grey-teal #2f4150 read as a dark checkerboard

crown._src: S6, median of the dark crown band under the parapet at (700,112)-(760,130) = #474643

sign._src: the white CASTILIAN sign panel (S6, S7, S8). S6's crop reads #a3a7a3 because that face is in shade; entered as the white it is.

groundGlass._src: S5, median of the ground-floor storefront glazing at (240,660)-(300,780)

groundWall._src: S5, median of the dark panel beside the storefront at (540,660)-(600,760)

canopy._src: the white soffit over the recessed ground floor (03)

colours._roof_src: S8 nadir, median of the tower roof membrane at (660,560)-(720,640) = #ded7c7; golden and night entered the way S11 enters a top face
colours._deckTone_src: S8 nadir, medians of the two podium roof strips: #e0e0e0 west (in sun) and #a5aaad east (in the tower's shadow); the entered day value is between them, moved down one step after the first look, where a paler deck read as a bare cream plane against the reference's weathered concrete

penthouseWhite._src: S8: the mechanical penthouse reads as the brightest white on the roof in both obliques; entered between the roof membrane and the podium white, not separately sampled

colours._condenser_src: S8 nadir: the roof units are mid grey; the trio is S11's mech tone, as The Standard's file uses it
colours._core_src: S12/03 core strip #cac9c7 in sun, a step greyer than the white piers; at night S13 reads it as the darkest vertical on the face
colours._signBack_src: S12/03 sign panel #e7e6e6 by day; S13 at night the panel is dark with the letters lit
colours._signInk_src: the letters are dark on the white panel by day (01, 03, 08) and glow cool white at night (S13)

accBlue._src: the American Campus logo on the south end wall (01, 08): teal blue

colours._finLight_src: S12/03 lit fin face #cfd6e2, screen average #d7dfe8; at night S13 the screen is lit from the garage behind and reads #4f515d, far brighter than the tower
colours._finMid_src: the pale-blue fin faces that give the screen its irregular stripes in 01/08
colours._finShade_src: S5 shaded fin face #6e809a, lifted toward 01's far-view average #ced7de

finJoint._src: the two dark sawtooth joints between the screen's three tiers (03, 05)

colours._pier_src: S12/03 median of a sunlit pilaster (1228,5)-(1245,120) = #eeeeee, entered a step down for the lit face; 01's end wall #f0efef
colours._spandrel_src: S12/03 median of the sloped spandrel under a window (1068,8)-(1098,18) = #b0b1b5
colours._endPale_src: S12/01 end wall #f0efef in sun; same material as the piers
colours._podiumWhite_src: white fascias above and below the amenity glass and under the screen (03, 01)

skins._src: one rule per face treatment; every count comes from a module, never a hard-coded number

grid._src: The long tower faces. Bay 3.9 m (S13 solve: eight bays over 31.3 m each side of the core); a white pilaster 0.75 m wide standing 0.35 m proud on every bay line (03 shows the relief); in each channel one wide landscape window, 3.0 x 1.7 m on a 1.0 m sill, the grey spandrel under it (03, S13).

core._src: the charcoal lift and stair core strip that runs the tower's full height on both long faces, carrying the vertical sign (S6, S7, S8); also the dark crown band, which is the same tone

end._src: the tower's end walls: blank white with one centred column of deep stair-landing openings, one per floor (01, 03, 08)

fin._src: The garage fin screen: 0.57 m pitch (S5), a shaded face on each fin, pale and pale-blue faces alternating irregularly (01, 08), three tiers split by two dark joints (03, 05).

amenity._src: level 11: continuous navy glazing on dark mullions (03), drawn as a flat dark field so it reads as the near-black ribbon every daylight photograph shows - the glass shader's sky reflection turned a storefront pane pale at the oblique camera (r3). Its night tone is the lit amenity floor behind it (S13).

ground._src: level 1: leasing office, retail and the Castilian Cafe (S3, S10) behind a storefront that sits back under the podium overhang, with a white canopy fascia (S4, S5). Mullion 1.6 m read off S5 at its own scale. The recess itself is not modelled - the wall is in the podium plane; see `open`.

endPier._src: the podium's share of the tower's end wall: blank pale precast, no fins, no windows (S4, S8). Same tone as the tower's end walls above it, because it is the same wall.

penthouse._src: the mechanical penthouse walls (S8) - unused while the penthouse is a roofItem box, kept so a future block can wear it

endPierW._src: the blank white end pier at each end of the long faces, ~3.7 m (S13)

crownW._src: the tower top is white to the parapet in every photograph (01, 08, S13); the old dark crown band was not there

southBase._src: the podium's short ends are solid white at street level (01, 03 - the arched door sits in it); only the west and east ground floors are recessed shopfronts

blocks._src: The full site, ground to the deck. West and east: recessed shopfront, white fascia, fin screen, white fascia, amenity glass, white band. South and north: the same stack in two screened sections either side of the stair pier, solid white at street level (01, 03, 08).

faces._src: u1 south, u0 north (north mirrored from the south - no photograph)

overrides._src: S12/01 solve: the white stair pier v 15.9-22.3 (15.2 with its shadowed return) runs the full podium height between the two screened sections
the east section's ground floor is a dark recess under its fascia (03)

blocks._src: The residential slab, levels 12-22, between its two end blocks. S13's solve puts the whole tower (ends included) from u -0.7 to 76.9 - the full podium length, not the 66.5 m the nadir gave - and S12's puts the south end wall at v 11.6-26.6, over the pier.

faces._src: the ends belong to the end blocks

overrides._src: the core strip at the middle of both long faces (S13: u 35.4-43.4), with THE CASTILIAN reading top to bottom on a white panel, lit at night

roofItems._src: the white mechanical penthouse over the core (01)

blocks._src: the north end block: blank white, 0.7 m proud of both long faces - the end walls read as separate slabs standing past the window grid in 01, 08 and S13 (the thin lit return at each end of S13's west face)
the south end block: the wide white end wall with the stair column and the American Campus mark (01, 08), overhanging the south podium face by 0.6 m (03 shows its soffit)

faces._src: s runs v1 -> v0 on the u1 face; the mark sits in the west half, above the stair column (01, 08)

open: North end: no photograph; mirrored from the south.
The tower's end piers rise about 1 m above the parapet in 01 and S13; not drawn.
Signs read top to bottom as bitmaps rotated from the dot font.

night._src: S13: about two windows in five lit, warm white, one per bay
